prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI sign-up concept
Input image role: source screenshot is a reference for sign-up layout, form fields, and public auth flow only.
Primary request: Redesign 01-A-01-sign-up/default.
Direction: editorial onboarding panel.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS window title bar, device frame, or watermark. Left side uses concise TOPIK writing value copy and three compact benefit chips; right side is a precise Ant Design-style account form. Preserve name, email, password, confirm password, password strength, agreement checkbox with terms/privacy links, sign-up CTA, Google sign-up, and existing-account login link.
Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design Form/Input.Password/Checkbox/Button UI, calm auth page.
Color palette: Mist canvas, Snow primary form card, Fog chips/dividers, Obsidian #09090b primary CTA only, neutral mascot accent if present.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans, compact density, weight-driven hierarchy, no letter spacing.
Constraints: validation and disabled/ready CTA space should be visible; no account existence claims; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, loud AI gradients, colorful CTA stack, purple/orange mascot blocks, oversized bubble cards, raw provider errors, watermark.
